newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers firm again, demand tails off.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers firm again, demand tails off.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices firmed a further $1 a tonne on Friday with relatively low bunker demand, while prices in the rest of Europe were steady,
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted in the range $88/$90 fob as barges rose to around $87 ex-wharf.
After a busy Thursday, the number of enquiries dwindled, but most suppliers questioned said total ARA buying still topped 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg also rose by about $1 in response to the Rotterdam gains of the past two days.
Mediterranean prices were unchanged and business in most ports was fairly quiet.
